# tenOever Laboratory

> A source-grounded scholarly resource on Benjamin tenOever and the tenOever laboratory: virology, antiviral immunity, RNA biology, programmable virology, influenza, viral evolution, and pandemic host response.

The curated corpus covers 63 publications from 2003–2025, not a complete or current bibliography. Preserve lab-led, co-led, collaborative, and training-period attribution. Distinguish demonstrated findings, interpretation, synthesis, and limitations. Historical statements about stopped work are bounded by this corpus. Cite original publications through their DOIs when using scientific findings.

## Human-readable resources
- [Home](https://tenoeverlab.us/)
- [Research](https://tenoeverlab.us/research/)
- [Discoveries](https://tenoeverlab.us/discoveries/)
- [Publications](https://tenoeverlab.us/publications/)
- [Scientific trajectory](https://tenoeverlab.us/trajectory/)
- [About](https://tenoeverlab.us/about/)
- [Editorial method](https://tenoeverlab.us/methods/)

## Structured resources
- [publications](https://tenoeverlab.us/data/publications.json): Publication metadata, full narrative sections, attribution, identifiers, and relationships
- [discoveries](https://tenoeverlab.us/data/discoveries.json): Discovery statements, full narratives, and evidence-to-publication mappings
- [research-areas](https://tenoeverlab.us/data/research-areas.json): Six research areas with themes, publications, and discoveries
- [themes](https://tenoeverlab.us/data/themes.json): Research area and theme membership
- [connections](https://tenoeverlab.us/data/connections.json): 129 documented directed publication relationships
- [claims](https://tenoeverlab.us/data/claims.json): Original claim-to-source mappings
- [vocabulary](https://tenoeverlab.us/data/vocabulary.json): Controlled terms and publication memberships
- [timeline](https://tenoeverlab.us/data/timeline.json): Chronology and scientific transitions
- [publication_inventory](https://tenoeverlab.us/data/publication_inventory.json): Source inventory, including an inventory-only entry; the 63 reviewed records define site coverage
- [search_index](https://tenoeverlab.us/data/search_index.json): Original search index
- [provenance](https://tenoeverlab.us/data/provenance.json): Source checksums and scope
